note: Travel and camping portal for Europe: countries hold attractions and campsites (one Place entity with a kind), a booking is a form with the required guest details that becomes a confirmed reservation through a paid transition (mail confirmation), reviews with a 1..5 rating live under the place and feed its derived rating. No accounts are asked for, so no identity or roles.
